# LDC Library

#### About Library Department

LDC law library exists to facilitate the Academic, Training, Law Reporting & Research functions of the Centre by providing relevant & timely legal information in both print and electronic format. The library is stocked with more than 15,000 volumes of books which include; law reports, bulletins, textbooks, periodicals, laws both local and foreign, and research papers.

The library is open to students from universities offering law as well as the legal fraternity including advocates, judges, magistrates, scholars/researchers and government officials.

Law development center comprises of two Libraries thus Main campus at Kampala and Mbarara Library campus. It is a closed access Library with a special collection of information resources on legal information. Library facilitates and supports the academic, Law reporting and research functions of the centre by availing an assortment of relevant legal materials in both print and electronic formats.

Library Core Values

  * Committed to provide a conducive environment to all its customers and stake holders.
  * Integrity: Library staff treats its users with transparency and honesty in its all its dealings
  * Respect: Library serve its users and stakeholders in a professional and courteous way while maintaining responsive interactions and respecting the opinions of all.

Library Objectives

  * To acquire legal information materials in both hard and soft copies from local and international sources.
  * To electronically process, store, retrieve and make accessible up to date legal information and
  * To provide a conducive environment for reading and research by using the appropriate as well as functional IT equipment, furniture and buildings.

 Library Staff Hierarchy 

  * Head Library
  * Librarian
  * Library Assistants
  * Computer Laboratory Attendant

#### Library Section I

This section has collections on Law Reports like:

  * East Africa Law Reports (EA)
  * All England law reports
  * Kings bench (KB)
  * Queen’s bench (QB)
  * Weekly Law Reports
  * Appeal cases
  * East African law reports
  * Kampala Law Reports
  * Common law reports
  * Presented Papers
  * Probate Law Reports
  * Uganda Commercial Law Reports
  * Journals and Reports
  * Odunga’s digest etc.
  * Judgments of High Court, Court of Appeal, Supreme Court and Constitutional Court.

#### Library Section II

This section has collections on Law Reports like:

  * Laws of Uganda
  * Textbooks, High Court Bulletins
  * News Papers
  * Court Forms
  * Newspapers etc.

#### Computer Laboratory

This section gives access to Online Law materials

#### Library Subscriptions

  * Student from other Institutions 5,000/=
  * Non-student 10,000/=
  * Annual Per student from other institutions 200,000/=
  * Annual subscription to non- students 500,000/=

#### Opening Hours

Monday – Friday: 8:30am – 1:00pm, 2:00pm – 5:00pm

Saturdays: 9:00am – 1:00pm, 2:00pm – 5:00pm

Sundays: 9:00pm – 1:00pm, 2:00pm – 4:00pm

Public Holidays: closed

### Law Development Centre

Kampala Campus

Plot No. 339, Kagugube, Off. Gadaffi Road
